comparisons.original_reviewed_wording: V4.1.1:2026 uses WCAG 2.2 in its web requirements, compared with WCAG 2.1 in V3.2.1:2021.
comparisons.final_wording: V4.1.1:2026 uses WCAG 2.2 in its web requirements, compared with WCAG 2.1 in V3.2.1:2021.
comparisons.literal_rendering: Web criteria advance from WCAG 2.1 to WCAG 2.2.
comparisons.limits: WCAG does not exhaust EN web requirements.

comparisons.original_reviewed_wording: V4.1.1:2026 places the WAD correspondence table in Annex ZA, Table ZA.1; V3.2.1:2021 used Annex A, Table A.1.
comparisons.final_wording: V4.1.1:2026 places the WAD web-content correspondence table in Annex ZA, Table ZA.1; V3.2.1:2021 used Annex A, Table A.1.
comparisons.sections: Annex ZA/Table ZA.1; Annex A/Table A.1
comparisons.literal_rendering: The web-content WAD mapping moves to Annex ZA.
comparisons.limits: These are web-content tables; mobile-app mappings are ZA.2/A.2.
comparisons.final_wording_recheck: Reviewer supplied this narrower wording; no additional independent recheck after research cutoff.

comparisons.original_reviewed_wording: V4.1.1:2026 retains clause 9.4.1.1 as Void; the Parsing requirement is removed, not the numbered slot.
comparisons.final_wording: V4.1.1:2026 retains clause 9.4.1.1 as Void; the Parsing requirement is removed, not the numbered slot.
comparisons.literal_rendering: The numbered slot remains without its former Parsing obligation.
comparisons.limits: Does not mean every issue formerly associated with parsing is irrelevant.

comparisons.original_reviewed_wording: Chapter 10 remains present, and Annex ZA expressly includes downloadable documents and forms. Their disappearance as individual rows in a comparison table must not be read as removal of document accessibility requirements.
comparisons.final_wording: Chapter 10 remains present, and Annex ZA expressly includes downloadable documents and forms. Their disappearance as individual rows in a comparison table must not be read as removal of document accessibility requirements.
comparisons.literal_rendering: Chapter 10 and the express downloadable-document scope remain.
comparisons.limits: Does not establish all old document requirements are unchanged.

comparisons.original_reviewed_wording: The new clauses 9.7 and 10.7 restrict blocking or overriding specified user preferences and accessibility features, subject to their stated conditions and essential-information/function exceptions. Software clause 11.7 also has platform and essential-function qualifications.
comparisons.final_wording: The new clauses 9.7 and 10.7 restrict blocking or overriding specified user preferences and accessibility features, subject to their stated conditions and essential-information/function exceptions. Software clause 11.7 also has platform and essential-function qualifications.
comparisons.literal_rendering: Preferences provisions have defined scope and essential-information/function exceptions.
comparisons.limits: Not all preferences, platforms or software are covered without conditions.

comparisons.original_reviewed_wording: V4.1.1:2026 clause 12.2 expressly includes support services in its scope; deletion of old clause identifiers is not evidence that all support-service requirements disappeared.
comparisons.final_wording: V4.1.1:2026 clause 12.2 expressly covers digitally available information about support services; deletion of old clause identifiers does not establish that every requirement relating to support services disappeared.
comparisons.literal_rendering: Digitally available service information follows the requirements appropriate to its format.
comparisons.limits: Does not establish preservation of old support-service duties themselves, particularly effective communication.
comparisons.final_wording_recheck: Reviewer supplied this narrower wording; no additional independent recheck after research cutoff.

comparisons.original_reviewed_wording: Clauses 5.6.1, 5.6.2, 5.7, 5.8 and 5.9 already exist in V3.2.1:2021; New in a WAD web mapping comparison does not mean newly invented requirements in the standard.
comparisons.final_wording: Clauses 5.6.1, 5.6.2, 5.7, 5.8 and 5.9 already exist in V3.2.1:2021; New in a WAD web mapping comparison does not mean newly invented requirements in the standard.
comparisons.literal_rendering: The listed identifiers and requirements existed in the previous edition.
comparisons.limits: Does not establish unchanged normative text or conditions.

comparisons.original_reviewed_wording: The grouped No change label for 9.1.1.1–9.2.4.7 misses at least the heading change at 9.1.2.2 from Captions to Subtitles.
comparisons.final_wording: The grouped No change label for 9.1.1.1–9.2.4.7 misses at least the heading change at 9.1.2.2 from Captions to Subtitles.
comparisons.literal_rendering: The heading changes although the referenced WCAG criterion retains Captions in its name.
comparisons.limits: Heading difference alone is not proof of substantive obligation change; article explicitly presents a title/number comparison.

independent_review.limits: Not a comprehensive normative comparison, current-law certification, human review or PR approval. Narrowed wording is the reviewer recommendation; no further independent recheck performed.
